document_metadata.document_title: MDEQ Volume 2 Stormwater Runoff Management Manual

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Capture and treat a water quality volume typically equal to the first 1 inch or first 1.5 inches of rainfall (Schueler's Simple Method). Wet detention — first 0.5 inch of runoff or 1.5 inches from impervious; dry retention / wetlands — first 1.0 inch of runoff or 2.5 inches from impervious.

evidence.excerpt: City of Gulfport MS4 follows MDEQ Volume 2

extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipality coverage via MDEQ Vol 2 (Jackson pattern).
